newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Port conditions update - Pakistan - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Pakistan - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

KARACHI, April 25 - Vessels waiting off port, one container, waiting for one day, two general cargo, first vessel waiting for two days, two loaders, first vessel waiting for two days, and three oil tankers, first vessel waiting for two days. Six other vessels waiting off port for own reasons.
